title: Measuring Specific Leaf Area and Water Content
author: Etienne Laliberté
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p3tdqnn

steps.title: Prepare Leaf Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the leaf sub-samples for scanning and weighing.

substeps.instruction: Select a sub-sample of leaves from the same bulk fresh leaf sample used for spectral reflectance and transmittance measurements, ensuring they are as similar as possible.
Select enough leaves to entirely fill the scanner bed; cut leaves larger than the scanner bed to scan in multiple files.
Cut the petiole of each leaf (for compound leaves, the petiole is the extension of the rachis beyond which there are no leaflets; keep the rachis on the leaf).

steps.title: Measure Fresh Leaf Mass
steps.instruction: Immediately weigh the selected leaves (with petioles removed) and record the leaf fresh mass (g).

substeps.instruction: Perform weighing as close as possible to spectral measurements.
Use a 3-decimal place balance if possible (2-decimal may suffice for very large leaves).
Keep fresh leaves in a sealed bag in which you have breathed into to prevent water loss.

steps.title: Store Samples for Rehydration
steps.instruction: Store the selected leaves in a sealed plastic bag containing a piece of damp paper towel (using deionised water) and the operator's breath.

substeps.instruction: Label the sealed plastic bag with the sample ID and/or a barcode label.
Store the sealed sample in the dark, in the fridge (never a freezer) or a chilled cooler for 12 h.

steps.title: Configure WinFOLIA Software
steps.instruction: Open WinFOLIA and configure the system settings.

substeps.instruction: Use the same settings as the last time WinFOLIA was run.
Select the scanner starting with 'WIA...' (ensure drivers are installed).
Verify Analysis > Parameters... are set as per the reference image.
Verify Image > Acquisition Parameters... are set as per the reference image (for Canon LiDE 220: scan in color at 150 dpi; use 300 dpi for very small leaves).
Set Analysis > Measurements... to 'Total Area Only'.

steps.title: Setup Data Storage
steps.instruction: Create and organize the data files and folders on the CABO shared Google Drive.

substeps.instruction: Create a new data file via Data > New File... and save it as YYYY-MM-DD-SiteID.txt in the 'leafscans' folder.
Create a new folder named YYYY-MM-DD-SiteID (without spaces) within the 'leafscans' folder to store the data file and acquired images.

steps.title: Scan and Analyze Leaf Area
steps.instruction: Scan the leaves and record the total leaf area (cm2).

substeps.instruction: Position leaves to fill the scanner bed: place leaf apex at the top, leave margins free, and ensure leaves do not overlap or fold.
Optionally, add the RezChecker target in the top left section of the image for color/resolution calibration.
Enter the Sample ID (must match the bulk fresh leaf sample ID) and the operator's name.
Ensure the scanner calibration file is loaded (refer to WinFOLIA manual if not).
Click on the scanned image to analyze the whole image or select a specific region to record the total leaf area (cm2).
If multiple scans are required for one sample, repeat the process and add an identifier to the Sample ID (e.g., 4663504-A, 4663504-B).
Save the analyzed image(s) in the Google Drive working folder, naming the file using the sample ID.

steps.title: Finalize WinFOLIA Session
steps.instruction: Once all leaf samples for the site/day are scanned and analyzed, close the data file using Data > Close File.

steps.title: Measure Rehydrated Leaf Mass
steps.instruction: Measure the mass of the leaves after the 12 h rehydration period.

substeps.instruction: Gently pat dry the rehydrated leaves to remove surface water.
Weigh the rehydrated leaves as a whole and record the rehydrated leaf mass (g) using a 3-decimal place balance (2-decimal for very large leaves).

steps.title: Dry and Weigh Leaves
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the leaves to determine the dry mass.

substeps.instruction: Transfer scanned leaves into a labeled paper envelope or small paper bag and staple it shut.
Dehydrate in a forced air drying oven at 65 ºC for 72 h.
Cool samples to room temperature in a dessicator prior to weighing; if unavailable, lower oven temperature to room temperature with forced air still on.
Weigh the dried leaves and record the leaf dry mass (g) using a 3 or 4-decimal-place balance (2-decimal for very large leaves).

steps.title: Calculate Leaf Indices
steps.instruction: Use the recorded measurements to calculate the following indices:

substeps.instruction: Specific Leaf Area (SLA; m2 kg-1): SLA = (LA ÷ LDM) ÷ 10
Leaf Mass per Area (LMA; g m-2): LMA = LDM ÷ (LA ÷ 10,000)
Leaf Dry Matter Content (LDMC; mg g-1): LDMC = (LDM × 1000) ÷ RLM
Leaf Water Content (LWC; mg g-1): LWC = 1000 - LDMC
Relative Water Content (RWC; %): RWC = [(LFM - LDM) ÷ (RLM - LDM)] × 100
Equivalent Water Thickness (EWT; g cm-2): EWT = (LFM - LDM) ÷ LA
Note: LA = total leaf area (cm2), LDM = total leaf dry mass (g), RLM = rehydrated leaf mass (g), LFM = total leaf fresh mass (g).
